# Subset ASPC
## Clustering 
```{r subset_ASPC}
seurat.combined.sct <- readRDS(params$seurat_integrated)
table(seurat.combined.sct$renamed_cluster)
seurat.combined.sct <- NormalizeData(seurat.combined.sct, assay = "RNA")
Idents(seurat.combined.sct) <- "renamed_cluster"
ASPC.cells <- subset(seurat.combined.sct, idents = c("ASPC"))
table(ASPC.cells$sample)

saveRDS(ASPC.cells,file.path(data_dir,paste0("ASPC.cells.rds")))

# split condition
split_seurat <- SplitObject(ASPC.cells, split.by = "sample")
split_seurat <- split_seurat[c("Chow","HFSC")]

seurat.list <- lapply(X = split_seurat, FUN = SCTransform, verbose = FALSE)
features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = seurat.list , nfeatures = 3000)
seurat.list <- PrepSCTIntegration(object.list = seurat.list, anchor.features = features)
seurat.anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(object.list = seurat.list, normalization.method = "SCT",
                                         anchor.features = features)
seurat.combined.sct.ASPC <- IntegrateData(anchorset = seurat.anchors, normalization.method = "SCT")
seurat.combined.sct.ASPC <- RunPCA(seurat.combined.sct.ASPC, verbose = FALSE)

# ElbowPlot
png(filename = './subset_ASPC/ASPC_ElbowPlot.png')
ElbowPlot(seurat.combined.sct.ASPC, ndim = 30)
dev.off()

ndims <- 20
seurat.combined.sct.ASPC <- RunUMAP(seurat.combined.sct.ASPC, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:ndims)
seurat.combined.sct.ASPC <- FindNeighbors(seurat.combined.sct.ASPC, dims = 1:ndims, verbose = FALSE)
seurat.combined.sct.ASPC <- FindClusters(seurat.combined.sct.ASPC, verbose = FALSE, resolution = seq(0.1,1,0.1))
for(res in seq(0.1,1,0.1)){
  cat("#### res:",res, "\n")
  Idents(seurat.combined.sct.ASPC) <- paste0("integrated_snn_res.", res)
  png(filename = sprintf('./subset_ASPC/res_new_%s.png', res))
  p2 <- DimPlot(seurat.combined.sct.ASPC, label = T)
  print(p2)
  dev.off()
  cat("\n")
  cat("\n")
}

# Cell counts
metadata = seurat.combined.sct.ASPC@meta.data 
png(filename = './subset_ASPC/cell_counts_newcutoff.png')
metadata %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=sample, fill=sample)) + 
  geom_bar() +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust=1)) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5, face="bold")) +
  ggtitle("NCells")
dev.off()
saveRDS(seurat.combined.sct.ASPC, file = file.path(data_dir, "seurat_combined_sct_umap_ASPC.rds"))
```

## FindMarker in ASPC Subtype
```{r FindMarker_ASPC}
# Markers
Idents(seurat.combined.sct.ASPC) <- "integrated_snn_res.0.6"
seurat.combined.sct.ASPC <- JoinLayers(seurat.combined.sct.ASPC)
ASPC.markers <- FindAllMarkers(seurat.combined.sct.ASPC, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)
#write.csv(ASPC.markers ,file = sprintf('./subset_ASPC/ASPC_marker.csv'), row.names = T)
write.csv(ASPC.markers ,file = sprintf('./subset_ASPC/ASPC_marker_renamed.csv'), row.names = T)
table(ASPC.markers$cluster)
ASPC.markers.sig <- ASPC.markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>% top_n(n = -30, wt = p_val)
ASPC.markers.top20 <- ASPC.markers.sig %>% group_by(cluster) %>% top_n(n = 20, wt = avg_log2FC) %>% dplyr::arrange(desc(avg_log2FC), .by_group = TRUE)
ASPC.markers.top20 <- data.frame(symbol=ASPC.markers.top20$gene,ASPC.markers.top20[,1:6])
write.csv(ASPC.markers.top20,file = sprintf('./subset_ASPC/ASPC_marker_top20.csv'), row.names = F)
#write.csv(ASPC.markers.top20,file = sprintf('./subset_ASPC/ASPC_marker_top10_renamed.csv'), row.names = F)


seurat.combined.sct.ASPC = readRDS("/Users/hueee/Lab/Feinberg\ Lab/Single_cell_adipose_tissue/subset_ASPC/data/2024-07-17/seurat_combined_sct_umap_ASPC.rds")
seurat.combined.sct.ASPC$sample_simple <- stringi::stri_sub(seurat.combined.sct.ASPC$orig.ident,-4,-1)
seurat.combined.sct.ASPC$DE_group <- paste0(seurat.combined.sct.ASPC$integrated_snn_res.0.3, "-", seurat.combined.sct.ASPC$sample_simple)

as.data.frame(table(seurat.combined.sct.ASPC$DE_group)) %>%
```

## Test Marker umap
```{r marker_umap}
markers.to.plot = c("Ly6a", "Dpp4", "Cd55", "Sfrp4","Pecam1",
                    "Pparg", "Fabp4", "Lpl", "Plin2", "Cd36","Icam1","Aoc3",
                     "F3")

markers.to.plot = c("Pi16", "Dpp4", "Cd55", "Sfrp4","Cd24",
                    "Pparg", "Fabp4", "Lpl", "Plin2", "Cd36","Icam1","Aoc3","Col4a1",
                    "F3","Fmo2","Prkd1","Bmper",
                    "Pecam1","Steap4","Pdgfra","Pdgfrb","Acta2")

DefaultAssay(seurat.combined.sct.ASPC) <- "RNA"
Idents(seurat.combined.sct.ASPC) <- "integrated_snn_res.0.6"
for(gene in markers.to.plot){
  if(gene %in% rownames(seurat.combined.sct.ASPC)){
    cat("### ",gene, "\n")
    png(filename = sprintf('./subset_ASPC/markers/markers_allsimple_%s.png', gene), width=6, height=6, units="in", res=100)
    p <- FeaturePlot(seurat.combined.sct.ASPC, 
                     features = gene, reduction = "umap",
                     order = TRUE,
                     label = TRUE,
                     min.cutoff = "q10")
    #split.by = "orig.ident")
    print(p)
    dev.off()
    cat("\n")
  }
  else{
    cat("### ",gene, " \n")
    cat("Not present in dataset \n")
  }
  cat("\n")
}
```

### stacked barplot 2
```{r barplot2}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)

# ----- Palette (hue = subcluster; shade = diet: Chow dark, HFSC light) -----
base_cols <- c(Areg="#BC3B29", FAP="#0171B5", ASC="#E18728", PreA="#1F864E", RMP="#7876B1")
fill_map  <- c(
  setNames(base_cols,              paste0(names(base_cols), ".Chow")),
  setNames(alpha(base_cols, 0.45), paste0(names(base_cols), ".HFSC"))
)

# ----- Build count table from Seurat metadata (robust) -----
meta <- seurat.combined.sct.ASPC.new@meta.data
ct_levels <- rev(c("Areg","FAP","ASC","PreA","RMP"))  # order shown on y-axis (top -> bottom)

df <- meta %>%
  count(`Cell Types` = sub_cluster, Groups = sample, name = "Numbers") %>%
  filter(Groups %in% c("Chow","HFSC")) %>%
  mutate(
    `Cell Types` = factor(`Cell Types`, levels = ct_levels),
    Groups = factor(Groups, levels = c("Chow","HFSC")),
    fill_id = interaction(`Cell Types`, Groups, sep = ".")
  )

# ----- Left panel: absolute counts (force Chow above HFSC) -----
C2 <- ggplot(df, aes(y = `Cell Types`, x = Numbers, fill = fill_id)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8, position = position_dodge2(width = 0.75, reverse = TRUE)) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = Numbers),
    position = position_dodge2(width = 0.75, reverse = TRUE),
    hjust = -0.15, size = 2.2, colour = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = fill_map) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 5, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 5)
  ) +
  xlab("Numbers") +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")

# ----- Right panel data: within-group percent + (optional) reversed stack order -----
dfp <- df %>%
  group_by(Groups) %>%
  mutate(pct = Numbers / sum(Numbers)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Flip stack order (comment out the next line if you don't want to flip)
stack_order <- rev(levels(df$`Cell Types`))

dfp <- dfp %>%
  mutate(
    fill_id = factor(
      as.character(fill_id),
      levels = c(paste0(stack_order, ".Chow"), paste0(stack_order, ".HFSC"))
    )
  )

stopifnot(sum(is.na(dfp$fill_id)) == 0)

# ----- Right panel: stacked percent (0–1 axis) + label >= 3% -----
D2 <- ggplot(dfp, aes(x = Groups, y = Numbers, fill = fill_id)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill", width = 0.8) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = ifelse(pct >= 0.03, percent(pct, accuracy = 0.1), "")),
    position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 1.8,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = fill_map, na.value = "grey80") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
    labels = number_format(accuracy = 0.01),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 6) +

    axis.line    = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, colour = "black"),
    panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.3, colour = "black")
  ) +
  xlab("Groups")
```

# Trajectory Analysis
```{r trajectory}
library(monocle3)
Idents(seurat.combined.sct.ASPC.new) <- "sub_cluster"
DefaultAssay(seurat.combined.sct.ASPC.new) <- "RNA"
# seurat对象转换为CDS对象
seurat.combined.sct.ASPC.new <- JoinLayers(seurat.combined.sct.ASPC.new)
data <-GetAssayData(seurat.combined.sct.ASPC.new, assay = 'RNA', slot = 'counts')
cell_metadata <- seurat.combined.sct.ASPC.new@meta.data
gene_annotation <- data.frame(gene_short_name = rownames(data),row.names = row.names(data))
cds <- new_cell_data_set(expression_data = data,
                         cell_metadata = cell_metadata,
                         gene_metadata = gene_annotation)
# Standardization 
cds <- preprocess_cds(cds, num_dim = 50)
plot_pc_variance_explained(cds)

#umap降维
cds <- reduce_dimension(cds,reduction_method = "UMAP",cores = 16, umap.fast_sgd=T) #umap.fast_sgd=T进行随机降维,cores为多线程运算数量,这两个参数都能加快处理速度
plot_cells(cds)
colnames(colData(cds))
#以之前的Seurat分群来添加颜色
p1 <- plot_cells(cds, reduction_method="UMAP", color_cells_by="sub_cluster") + ggtitle('cds.umap')
p1

# 导入seurat对象的UAMP坐标信息
cds.embed <- cds@int_colData$reducedDims$UMAP
int.embed <- Embeddings(seurat.combined.sct.ASPC.new, reduction = "umap")
int.embed <- int.embed[rownames(cds.embed),]
cds@int_colData$reducedDims$UMAP <- int.embed
p2 <- plot_cells(cds, reduction_method="UMAP", color_cells_by="sub_cluster") + ggtitle('int.umap')
p2

# 识别细胞轨迹
cds <- cluster_cells(cds,cluster_method = "louvain")
plot_cells(cds, color_cells_by = "sub_cluster")
cds <- learn_graph(cds)
p = plot_cells(cds, color_cells_by = "sub_cluster", label_groups_by_cluster=FALSE,
               label_leaves=FALSE, label_branch_points=FALSE)
# ggsave("./subset_Macro/Trajectory.pdf", plot = p, width = 7, height = 6)

p=plot_cells(cds,
           color_cells_by = "sub_cluster",
           trajectory_graph_color = "#2f4f4f",
           label_cell_groups=FALSE,
           label_leaves=TRUE,
           label_branch_points=TRUE,
           graph_label_size=2.3,
           cell_size = 0.7)+ scale_color_nejm()
ggsave("./subset_ASPC/embryo.time.bin.new.pdf", plot = p, width = 7.5, height = 6)

cds <- order_cells(cds)
p1 = plot_cells(cds, 
               color_cells_by = "pseudotime", 
               label_cell_groups = TRUE, 
               label_leaves = FALSE,
               label_branch_points = FALSE,
               cell_size = 0.7)
ggsave("./subset_ASPC/Trajectory_Pseudotime_new.pdf", plot = p1, width = 7.5, height = 6)
```

# Differential Expression Analysis
## MultInput
```{r DEA}
# Define the cell types
Idents(seurat.combined.sct.ASPC.new) <- "DE_subgroup"
cell_types <- c("Areg","FAP","ASC","PreA","RMP")
# Define the conditions
condition1 <- "HFSC"
condition2 <- "Chow"
# Initialize an empty list to store data frames
markers_list <- list()
# Loop through each cell type and perform the operations
for (cell_type in cell_types) {
  # Join the layers (if needed, you might skip this if it's already done)
  seurat.combined.sct.ASPC.new <- JoinLayers(seurat.combined.sct.ASPC.new)
  # Create the identifiers for the conditions
  ident1 <- paste(cell_type, condition1, sep = "-")
  ident2 <- paste(cell_type, condition2, sep = "-")
  # Find markers
  markers <- FindMarkers(object = seurat.combined.sct.ASPC.new, ident.1 = ident1, ident.2 = ident2)
  # Convert markers to data frame and arrange by adjusted p-value
  markers_df <- markers %>% 
    as.data.frame() %>% 
    rownames_to_column(var = "gene") %>% 
    arrange(p_val_adj) %>%
    mutate(CellTypes = cell_type)
  # Save the results
  saveRDS(markers_df, file = file.path("./subset_ASPC/results/2024-07-17/DEAnalysis", paste(cell_type, "-DEMarkers.rds", sep = "")))
  # Append the data frame to the list
  markers_list[[cell_type]] <- markers_df
}

# Combine all data frames in the list into one data frame
combined_markers_df <- bind_rows(markers_list)
write.csv(combined_markers_df,"./subset_ASPC/results/2024-07-17/DEAnalysis/combined_markers_df.csv",row.names = F)

combined_markers_df <- read.csv("./subset_ASPC/results/2024-07-17/DEAnalysis/combined_markers_df.csv")

# Display the combined data frame
combined_markers_df_P0.1 <- combined_markers_df %>%
  filter((avg_log2FC > 1 | avg_log2FC < -1) & p_val < 0.1)
table(combined_markers_df_P0.1$CellTypes)
multiVolcano_input <- combined_markers_df_P0.1[,c("gene","p_val","avg_log2FC","CellTypes")]
colnames(multiVolcano_input) <- c("Name","PValue","logFC","Cluster")
```

## MultiVolcano
```{r multiVolcano}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)   # 用于标记

mycol <- c("#BC3C28","#0072B5","#E18727","#1F854E","#7876B1")

# 自定义一个函数，之后我们直接调用它
mutiVolcano = function(df,         # 绘图数据
                       P,   # P值卡值
                       logFC,   # logFC卡值
                       GroupName,      # 分组标签
                       pointColor, # 分组散点的颜色
                       barFill = "#efefef",  # 柱子的颜色
                       pointSize = 0.5,      # 散点的大小
                       labeltype = "1",      # 标记差异基因的选项，标记类型有"1"和"2"两种选项
                       labelNum = 5,         # 当标记类型为1时，待标记的散点个数
                       labelName = NULL,      # 当标记类型为2时，待标记的散点名称
                       tileLabel =  "Label", # 标记比较对的选项，选项有“Label”和“Num”，Label时显示分组名称，Num时显示数字，防止因为标签太长导致的不美观
                       tileLable_size,
                       tileColor = NULL      # 比较对的颜色
                       ){
  # 数据分组 根据p的卡值分组
  dfSig = df %>%
    filter(logFC>{{logFC}} | logFC <((-1)*{{logFC}})) %>%
    mutate(Group = ifelse(PValue<{{P}},GroupName[[1]],GroupName[[2]])) %>%
    mutate(Group = factor(Group,levels=GroupName)) %>%
    mutate(Cluster = factor(Cluster,levels=unique(Cluster)))   # Cluster的顺序是文件中出现的顺序
  
  # 柱形图数据整理
  dfBar = dfSig %>%
    group_by(Cluster) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(min = min(logFC, na.rm = T),
              max = max(logFC, na.rm = T)
              )
  # 散点图数据整理
  dfJitter = dfSig %>%
    mutate(jitter = jitter(as.numeric(Cluster),factor = 2))
  dfJitter
  
  # 整理标记差异基因的数据
  if(labeltype == "1"){
    # 标记一
    # 每组P值最小的几个
    dfLabel = dfJitter %>%
      group_by(Cluster) %>%
      slice_max(abs(logFC),n=labelNum,with_ties = F) %>%
      ungroup()
  }else if(labeltype == "2"){
    # 标记二
    # 指定标记
    dfLabel = dfJitter %>%
      filter(Name %in% labelName)
  }else{
    dfLabel = dfJitter %>% slice()
  }
    
  # 绘图
  p = ggplot()+
    # 绘制柱形图
    geom_col(data = dfBar, aes(x=Cluster,y=max), fill = barFill)+
    geom_col(data = dfBar, aes(x=Cluster,y=min), fill = barFill)+
    # 绘制散点图
    geom_point(data = dfJitter,
               aes(x = jitter, y = logFC, color = Group),
               size = pointSize,
               show.legend = NA
               )+
    # 绘制中间的标签方块
    ggplot2::geom_tile(data = dfSig,
                       ggplot2::aes(x = Cluster, y = 0, fill = Cluster), 
                       color = "black",
                       height = 1.5,
                       # alpha = 0.3,
                       show.legend = NA,
                       ) + 
    # 标记差异基因
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = dfLabel,
      aes(x = jitter,                   # geom_text_repel 标记函数
          y = logFC,          
          label=Name),        
      min.segment.length = 0.1,
      max.overlaps = 10000,               # 最大覆盖率，当点很多时，有些标记会被覆盖，调大该值则不被覆盖，反之。
      size=2.5,                             # 字体大小
      box.padding=unit(0.5,'lines'),      # 标记的边距
      point.padding=unit(0.05, 'lines'), 
      segment.color='black',              # 标记线条的颜色
      show.legend=F)
  
  if(tileLabel=="Label"){
     p =
      p +
      geom_text(data = dfSig,aes(x = Cluster,y = 0,label = Cluster),size = tileLable_size)+
      ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = tileColor,
                                 guide = NULL # 不显示该图例
                                 )
  }else if(tileLabel=="Num"){
    # 如果比较对的名字太长，可以改成数字标签
    p =
      p +
      geom_text(data = dfSig,aes(x = Cluster,y = 0,label = as.numeric(Cluster)),show.legend = NA)+
      ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = tileColor,
                                 labels = c(paste0(1:length(unique(dfSig$Cluster)),": ",unique(dfSig$Cluster))))
  }

  # 修改主题
  p = p+ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = pointColor)+
    theme_classic()+
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 5) + 
    ggplot2::theme(
                   legend.position = "right", 
                   legend.title = ggplot2::element_blank(), 
                   legend.background = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                   axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                   axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
                   # axis.title.x = element_blank(),
                   axis.line.x = element_blank()
                   ) + 
    ggplot2::xlab("Clusters") + ggplot2::ylab("log2FC") + 
    # ggplot2::guides(fill = ggplot2::guide_legend())
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3)))
    return(p)
}

df <- as_tibble(multiVolcano_input)
# Run multiVolcano
mutiVolcano(
  df = df,    # 绘图数据
  P = 0.05,   # P值卡值
  logFC = 1,   # FC卡值
  GroupName = c("P-value < 0.05","P-value >= 0.05"),      # 分组标签
  pointColor = c("#dc143c","#0099CC"), # 分组散点的颜色
  barFill = "#efefef",   # 柱子的颜色
  pointSize = 0.3,   # 散点的大小
  labeltype = "1",   # 标记差异基因的选项，标记类型有"1"和"2"两种选项:
                     # 当标记类型为1时，待标记的散点个数:当标记类型为2时，待标记的散点名称
  tileLable_size = 2.8,
  tileLabel =  "Label",           # 标记比较对的选项，选项有“Label”和“Num”，Label时显示分组名称，
                                  # Num时显示数字，防止因为标签太长导致的不美观
  tileColor = mycol  # 比较对的颜色
  ) +
  labs(title="Distribution of Differentially Expressed Genes \nin Individual ASPC Subpopulations")
ggsave("./subset_ASPC/mutiVolcano.pdf", width = 6, height = 4)
ggsave("./subset_ASPC/mutiVolcano.png", width = 6, height = 4,dpi = 500)
```

## DE_Aregs
```{r DE_Aregs}
Idents(seurat.combined.sct.ASPC.new) <- "DE_subgroup"
markers_Areg <- FindMarkers(object = seurat.combined.sct.ASPC.new, ident.1 = "Areg-HFSC", ident.2 = "Areg-Chow")
markers_Areg_df <- markers_Areg %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "gene") %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(p_val_adj)
saveRDS(markers_Areg_df, file = file.path("./subset_ASPC/results/2024-07-17/DEAnalysis/", "markers_Areg.rds"))
rio::export(markers_Areg_df, file = file.path(results_dir,paste0("DE_results_", "Areg-HFSC_vs_Chow",".csv")))
markers_Areg_df_sig <- markers_Areg_df %>% dplyr::filter(p_val_adj <= 0.1)
rio::export(markers_Areg_df_sig, file = file.path(results_dir,paste0("DE_results_",
                                                                 "Areg-HFSC_vs_Chow",
                                                                 "_sig0.1",
                                                                 ".csv")))

```
